title: B2B Telesales - 3-month contract
description:
B2 B Telesales Executive

Full-Time 3-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Salary DOE + Monthly Commission
Crawley (Hybrid Working Available)

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a B2 B Telesales Executive to join a well-established and highly respected business on a 3-month fixed-term contract.

This is a fast-paced, sales-focused role where you'll be responsible for generating new business, growing revenue, and building strong relationships with customers. Working as part of a supportive team, you'll engage with prospective and existing clients, identify opportunities, and contribute to ambitious growth targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Generate new sales through outbound B2 B telesales activity.
- Identify and prospect new business opportunities.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
- Use CRM systems to manage leads and update customer information accurately.
- Work closely with internal teams to support subscription growth initiatives.

What We're Looking For
- Previous B2 B telesales experience is essential.
- A confident and professional communicator with strong relationship-building skills.
- Comfortable working towards sales targets.
- Experience using CRM systems.
- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
- Open to candidates from a variety of industry backgrounds.

Additional Information
- Immediate start required.
- Hybrid working available, with an expectation of 2-3 days per week in the Crawley office, although some flexibility may be offered.

If you're a driven sales professional looking for your next opportunity and can hit the ground running, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success & Sales Executive
description:
Customer Success & Sales Executive

Salary: 27,000 per annum basic + monthly Bonus (OTE 32,000+)
Contract: Permanent Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm + 1 short Saturday per month
Location: Office-based in Hove / Portslade

Join a growing team with warm leads only - no cold calling!

We're looking for a Customer Success & Sales Executive to join an established and expanding organisation in Hove / Portslade. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone passionate about customer service and sales to work in a thriving, supportive environment.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive - Machinery Sales
Chichester
Full-Time Permanent Office Based

Are you passionate about machinery or technical products and enjoy building strong customer relationships? An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Machinery Sales Executive to join a successful, family-run business supplying specialist equipment across the South of England. The Machinery Sales Executive role is about much more than simply closing sales. This is NOT a cold calling sales role, but more consultative with inbound sales conversions. You'll develop long-term relationships with new and existing customers, understand their requirements and guide them through the process from initial enquiry to purchase and aftercare.

As a Machinery Sales Executive, you'll represent a range of respected machinery products across sectors including agriculture, construction, groundscare and forestry. You'll have the opportunity to develop your product knowledge through manufacturer-specific training while becoming a valued member of a close-knit team.

Key Responsibilities
- Generate and develop machinery sales opportunities from initial enquiry to completion
- Build and nurture strong relationships with new and existing customers
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery solutions
- Promote and develop the company's machinery product portfolio
- Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the sales process
- Attend occasional trade shows and industry events
- Work collaboratively with the sales team to manage stock levels
- Support social media activity and product promotion

Skills & Experience
- Strong knowledge and understanding of machinery/large technical products
- Confident, engaging and customer-focused communication style
- Genuine ability to build and maintain lasting relationships
- Commercially driven with a strong desire to succeed
- Excellent attention to detail and follow-through
- Organised approach with the ability to manage leads effectively
- Positive team player with a proactive attitude

Salary
Up to £40,000 per year depending on experience

Working Hours
8am - 5pm Monday to Friday (1:4 Saturday mornings may be introduced with a Friday afternoon given in lieu)

Benefits
- Competitive salary based on experience
- Company pension
- Product-specific training
- Staff events and social activities
- Flexible package for the right candidate
- Free on-site parking

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive B2 B

Location: Crawley Free Parking

Salary: £27k - £32k starting salary

OTE: £55k - £60k uncapped

Info: Fantastic benefits, training, and career growth opportunities.

B2 B Sales Executive - £55k-£60k OTE

Crawley

£27,000 - £32,000 starting salary

£55,000-£60,000 realistic OTE Uncapped commission

Established top performers earning £65,000+

If you're looking for a career in sales but want better earning potential, excellent training and somewhere you can genuinely progress, this could be a great move.

Our client is an established market leader in business technology solutions providing essential products and services to companies across the UK.

You'll work with both existing and new B2 B customers, receive excellent training and ongoing support from experienced sales leaders, and have a realistic opportunity to earn £55k-£65k with uncapped commission.

Just as importantly, if you're ambitious about your career as well as your earnings, there are genuine opportunities to progress into senior sales, field sales and management.

The Role

As a Sales Executive, you'll speak with existing customers and new business clients about their communication and technology requirements.

You'll be:
- Building relationships with existing B2 B customers and identifying opportunities for renewals, upgrades and additional services.
- Speaking with new business customers and developing new sales opportunities.
- Advising clients on business-critical technology products and solutions.
- Working alongside the field sales team on larger client opportunities.
- Managing your own sales pipeline and working towards clear targets.

You'll be joining an established and professional sales operation with excellent technology, training and experienced leadership around you.

Salary & Commission

You'll start on a £27,000 - £32,000 basic salary, with the opportunity to increase quickly, plus an attractive uncapped commission structure.

£55,000-£60,000 OTE is realistic, with established top performers earning £65,000+.

Perform well and there is no ceiling on what you can earn or where this role can take you.

About You

We're open-minded about where you've gained your experience.

B2 B sales experience would be an advantage, but we'll also consider good salespeople from other backgrounds who have the communication skills, attitude and ambition to succeed.

You may currently work in B2 B Sales, Inside Sales, Telesales, Account Management, Business Development, Customer Retention or a similar role.

More importantly, you'll be someone who:
- Enjoys speaking with customers and building relationships.
- Is motivated by achieving results and earning good commission.
- Is confident, ambitious and takes ownership of their performance.
- Enjoys being part of a successful and supportive sales team.
- Wants to develop their skills and progress their career.

You don't need previous experience in technology or communications. You'll receive structured product and sales training, followed by ongoing coaching and support from experienced sales leaders.

Career Progression

This is a business that invests in its people and has a strong culture of developing and promoting from within.

So, if you're looking for somewhere you can increase your earnings now while building a longer-term sales career, there is plenty of opportunity to do both.

What You'll Get
- £27,000 - £32,000 starting salary
- £50,000-£60,000 realistic OTE.
- Uncapped commission with established top performers earning £65,000+.
- Structured product and sales training.
- Ongoing coaching and support from experienced sales leaders.
- Genuine opportunities for internal promotion.
- Career paths into senior sales, field sales and management.
- Excellent company benefits and incentives.
- Regular social events and a strong team culture.
- Free parking at the office
- The stability and backing of an established market-leading business.

When You Apply

We believe recruitment should be straightforward and personal.

Every application to Red Rhino Solutions is read by an experienced recruiter - not an automated screening system.

There are no bots or automated conversations. If we contact you, you'll speak with a real person who knows the company intimately, understands the role and can answer your questions properly.

Interested? Apply today and we'll personally review your application.

Follow us on LinkedIn for more job opportunities.

Red Rhino Solutions

A Rare Breed

title: Sales Representative (Leisure Marine)
company: Grafters Recruitment Consultants Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Hailsham, East Sussex

Join our clients dynamic team as a Sales Executive and drive your career forward with them! They are a leading company in the synthetic rope industry, committed to delivering market leading products, exceptional service and innovative solutions to their customers.

Role Overview: They are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Executive to join their Leisure Marine team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, building strong customer relationships, and achieving targets. If you have a passion for sales and a knack for connecting with people, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities:
- Driving their van, stocked with product around chandleries and boatyards, selling marine equipment to achieve targets.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
- Provide excellent customer service and support.
- Keep up-to-date with product knowledge and market trends.

- Keen interest in the marine, yachting or related industries.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and closing skills.
- Self-motivated and target-driven.
- Valid and clean driver's license.
- Ability and willingness to travel and stay away from home if and when necessary

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
Job Title: Sales Account Executive

Location: Chichester, West Sussex

Salary: £28,000-£32,000 basic depending on experience (OTE £50,000+)

Working Pattern: Full Time Office Based

The Opportunity

Solid Recruitment is delighted to represent a well-established international business working with some of the world's leading technology organisations. As part of my client's continued growth, they are opening a new office in Chichester with a clear ambition: to build and develop the next generation of high-performing sales professionals.

My client is looking for an ambitious Sales Account Executive to become one of the first members of their new Chichester team. You will have the opportunity to develop your sales career from the ground up, combining hands-on experience with dedicated one-to-one mentorship from the company's Associate Managing Director and one of its most established and successful sales professionals.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, thrives on speaking with people, and wants to develop a long-term career in sales within a growing international business where progression is genuinely available.

About the Role

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging carefully targeted businesses, introducing my client's services, and creating high-quality sales opportunities.

Using a combination of phone calls, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and personalised video outreach, you will build relationships with senior decision-makers, understand their business challenges, and generate qualified appointments. A key part of the role will be your ongoing development, working closely with the Associate Managing Director to receive dedicated coaching designed to accelerate your growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively identify and approach well-qualified prospective clients.
- Conduct consultative outbound calls with senior decision-makers.
- Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research and engage target businesses.
- Follow a proven new-business outreach framework to identify and qualify prospective clients.
- Create and send personalised video messages to prospective clients.
- Build strong, professional relationships and understand prospective clients' challenges.
- Qualify opportunities, manage leads effectively through the sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records.
- Work closely with colleagues and consistently work towards and exceed activity and sales targets.

About You
- Previous experience in sales, business development, or account management.
- Confidence making outbound calls, building rapport quickly, and communicating effectively.
- A consultative approach and a genuine interest in understanding business challenges.
- Confidence using technology, social selling, and video communication.
- A self-motivated, positive, and resilient attitude with strong organisation and attention to detail.
- A willingness to learn, take feedback, and continually improve to build a successful sales career.

What's on Offer
- Salary: £28,000-£32,000 basic salary with a realistic OTE of £50,000+.
- Mentorship: Dedicated one-to-one mentorship from the Associate Managing Director and top-performing sales leadership.
- Growth: The chance to become a founding member of my client's new Chichester office with clear pathways for career progression.
- Development: Comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, and professional development.
- Perks: Quarterly company social events and an annual overseas business convention.
- Culture: A supportive, collaborative, and ambitious working environment where success is recognized and rewarded.

How to Apply

Ready to build your sales career? Apply directly through Solid Recruitment today to discuss this opportunity
